title: Giant teddy bear on the Cal Hacks stage
summary: A short, quiet recording of a giant tan teddy bear sitting on an empty stage. Behind it hangs a starry blue Cal Hacks 13.0 banner with a cartoon bear flying a red airplane. No people appear and no speech was recorded.

title: Table with the Claude tablecloth
summary: The recording slowly circles an empty table covered with a dark cloth printed with the word "Claude" and an orange starburst. White folding chairs stand behind it, and a tall "Claude" banner stands beside it. No people appear and no one speaks.

title: Giant lighted letters in a large hall
summary: The camera moves slowly around a row of giant white letters standing on a raised platform, each dotted with small lights. In the background, a large hall holds a "Cal HACKS 13.0" banner, people resting on the floor, and a few people walking by. No speech was recorded.

title: Hardware Lab table
summary: The recording shows a blue table with a Major League Hacking "Hardware Lab" tablecloth in a room with white walls and a concrete floor. Three stacked boxes and some cards sit on a second blue table beside it, and a person in dark clothes lies on the floor by the wall. The view stays on the same scene the whole time.
